product.name: Focus Planner
product.subtitle: Undated · One Thing At A Time

positioning.scope: attention — what gets it, what steals it, what restores it
positioning.one_line: A planner for the block of time itself: planned before it starts, logged after it ends, and reviewed until the pattern is visible.

primary: People who work in an interrupt-heavy environment

differentiators: A session plan filled before the block, not a to-do list
Deep Focus Log with depth rating and stated output
Distraction and interruption logged separately — internal versus external
A written Recovery Plan for the moment attention breaks
Break planning treated as part of the work, not the reward
Energy tracked hour by hour so hard work is scheduled where energy already is
Thirteen-week Progress Dashboard — the pattern only appears at that length
Four sizes, verified page and link parity

differs_from.001-business-productivity-planner: Runs a business; focus is one section
differs_from.005-goal-planner: The goal is the unit; this plans the hour that serves it
differs_from.006-weekly-productivity-planner: The week is the unit; this is the block inside the day
differs_from.007-daily-productivity-planner: Plans the whole day; this plans a single session and what protects it
differs_from.008-time-blocking-planner: The calendar slot is the unit — allocation. This is what happens inside the slot
differs_from.010-deep-work-planner: Longer-horizon deep work projects; this is session-level execution

compatibility.print: 100% scale, no bleed required, 100–120 gsm recommended
